The archive includes a locally trained Stable Diffusion 1.5 LoRA:
  artifacts/body-horror-lora/lora/pytorch_lora_weights.safetensors
  Base: stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5
  Modifications: rank-8 adapter, 400 training steps, synthetic body-horror data.
  This is an experimental local derivative, not an official upstream release.
  The base model's CreativeML Open RAIL-M license is included in
  Stable-Diffusion-LICENSE; its use restrictions apply to the derivative.
  Source: https://huggingface.co/stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5
  License source: https://github.com/CompVis/stable-diffusion/blob/main/LICENSE

Base weights are downloaded by setup_3d.sh, not embedded in this ZIP:
  SD 1.5 — CreativeML Open RAIL-M
  https://huggingface.co/stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5
  LCM-LoRA SD 1.5 — OpenRAIL++
  https://huggingface.co/latent-consistency/lcm-lora-sdv1-5
  TripoSR — MIT
  https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/TripoSR
  DINO ViT-B/16 configuration used by TripoSR's image encoder
  https://huggingface.co/facebook/dino-vitb16

TripoSR code is fetched from VAST-AI-Research/TripoSR at a pinned revision.
Its MIT license is also included in TripoSR-LICENSE.
https://github.com/VAST-AI-Research/TripoSR

Godot and uv are downloaded during setup; each retains its upstream license.
Python dependency versions and sources are recorded in uv.lock.
The archive does not relicense third-party components.
